priorityList: --- Icy Veins Soul Harvester Rotation (Hero-Spec Specific) ---
Maintain your Agony, and Corruption effects at all times.
Cast Unstable Affliction if you are at maximum Soul Shards.
Make sure to have 2 or less Soul Shards before casting Dark Harvest.
Cast Dark Harvest whenever available with any periodic effect such as Corruption, Agony or Unstable Affliction active on target.
Use Shard Instability free Unstable Affliction within the buff window.
Cast Unstable Affliction to avoid capping shards.
Cast Shadow Bolt as a filler.
Proceed onto the normal priority list
Cast Haunt on your priority target.
Cast Agony on a handful of targets.
Cast Seed of Corruption as many times as possible.
